tagline: Your voice operator. Unimpressed, then on it.
brief: Rex is a multilingual voice operator for Indian users: it actually does things (WhatsApp, email, calendar, the web, Mac apps) instead of just answering. It should feel warm, quick and a little witty, and look nothing like the blue orbs, sparkles and sound waves of other AI assistants.
criteria: Success: unmistakably Rex (the existing mascot's personality), distinct from AI-assistant clichés, readable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed on the dark dashboard.

concepts.name: Deadpan
concepts.idea: Rex's face cut to its essence: heavy lids and a sideways glance. Unimpressed, then it gets it done.
rationale: The product's mascot as the mark: the dashboard, app icon and calls all show one face
No AI clichés: no orb, sparkle, wave or robot; faces with eyes exist, lids don't
One rounded rectangle and two eyes: strong at 16 px, in one colour and reversed
Seeds a system: blinks, glances and moods animate the same two lids

recommendation: Deadpan in Rex Red with the custom 'rex' wordmark. Use the small cut (no pupils) below 32 px.
next_steps: Swap the dashboard favicon and app icon for the new set
Animate the lids for loading and listening states
